tasks.title: A minimal document
tasks.statement: Write a page skeleton from scratch: a doctype, an html element with language ru, and in the head the utf-8 encoding, a viewport (width=device-width) and the page title “Кофейня” (Coffee Shop). In the body, put a level-one heading.
tasks.hint: Order: <!doctype html>, then html lang="ru" with two children, head and body. The head holds meta charset, meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" and title.

tasks.title: The page head
tasks.statement: Complete the document head: the page must have the title “Рецепты” (Recipes), the utf-8 encoding, a viewport with width=device-width, the style.css stylesheet and the app.js script loaded with defer.
tasks.hint: Stylesheets are attached with link rel="stylesheet" and href. The script needs the defer attribute, not async.

tasks.title: Headings without gaps
tasks.statement: The heading levels on the page are mixed up: an h3 comes right after the h1. Fix them: the sections “Сорта” (Varieties) and “Заварка” (Brewing) are level-two headings, while “Арабика” (Arabica) and “Робуста” (Robusta) are level-three. There must be no level-four headings.
tasks.hint: Pick the level by position in the structure: h1 is the title, h2 are sections, h3 are parts of sections. Do not skip levels.

tasks.title: Navigation as a list of links
tasks.statement: Build the site menu: a nav element containing a bulleted list of three items with the links “Главная” (Home), “Меню” (Menu) and “Контакты” (Contacts). Each link must have an href.
tasks.hint: A menu is a list of links: nav > ul > li > a. Each li contains one link.

tasks.title: Header, main, footer
tasks.statement: The page is made of paragraphs. Mark it up with semantic containers: the site name goes in a header, the main text in a main, the copyright line in a footer. The containers come in that order, one each, directly in the body.
tasks.hint: You need header, main and footer elements; there is only one main per page. Keep the text and change only the wrappers.

tasks.title: An article with a date
tasks.statement: Mark up a blog post. The page title “Блог” (Blog) is an h1. The post itself is an article element containing a level-two heading, the date in a time element with a datetime attribute, and a paragraph of text.
tasks.hint: Write time like this: <time datetime="2026-05-06">6 May 2026</time>. The post heading is an h2, because the h1 is already taken by the blog title.

tasks.title: An external link
tasks.statement: The link points to someone else's site. Make it open in a new tab safely: add target and a rel with both protection values. Keep the text and the address.
tasks.hint: target="_blank" opens a new tab, and rel="noopener noreferrer" stops the opened page from controlling yours.

tasks.title: An anchor link
tasks.statement: Turn the “К ценам” (To prices) link into an anchor: it must lead to the “Цены” (Prices) heading on the same page. To do that, give the heading the id prices, and give the link an address made of a hash sign and that id.
tasks.hint: An identifier is set with the id attribute, and a link to it starts with a hash sign: href="#prices".

tasks.title: A definition list
tasks.statement: The terms are written as paragraphs. Turn them into a definition list: a dl element, each term in a dt, each explanation in a dd. No paragraphs may remain.
tasks.hint: The structure of a pair is <dt>term</dt><dd>explanation</dd>, with all pairs inside one dl.

tasks.title: A quotation with a source
tasks.statement: Mark up the phrase as a quotation: a long one, using a blockquote element with a cite attribute holding the source address (starting with https). The wrapper paragraph is not needed.
tasks.hint: blockquote is a quotation set off as a block; the address of the original source goes in cite: <blockquote cite="https://…">.

tasks.title: Code in pre and code
tasks.statement: A short listing is typed as a paragraph with line breaks made by br. Mark it up properly: multi-line code goes in a pre, and inside the pre goes a code element. There must be no br elements.
tasks.hint:
Spaces and line breaks inside pre are preserved, so br is not needed. Structure: 
…
.

tasks.title: From div soup to semantics
tasks.statement: The page is built entirely from divs with classes. Rewrite it: a header with the name and navigation (a nav with a list of links), a main with an h1 heading and a paragraph, and a footer. No divs with classes may remain.
tasks.hint: div.top → header, div.menu → nav with a ul list, div.content → main, div.title → h1, div.text → p, div.bottom → footer. Menu items are li with a link.

tasks.title: A picture with a caption
tasks.statement: Mark up an illustration: a figure element containing an img with a short description in alt, and a caption in figcaption. Keep the file path.
tasks.hint: Structure: . The alt description must not be empty.

tasks.title: Small semantic elements
tasks.statement: The paragraph contains an abbreviation, a date and an important remark. Mark them up: HTML with an abbr element whose expansion is in title, the date with a time element with datetime="2026-05-06", the words “очень важно” (very important) with a strong element, and the word “разметки” (markup) with a mark element.
tasks.hint: abbr gets its expansion in title, time gets the machine-readable date in datetime, strong marks importance, mark highlights for search. You do not need to change the paragraph text.

tasks.title: No obsolete tags
tasks.statement: The fragment is written the 1990s way: centering and color are done with center and font. Rewrite it: the heading “Распродажа” (Sale) is an h1, the text is a p paragraph. There must be no center or font tags and no style, color or align attributes.
tasks.hint: Presentation is a job for styles, not markup. The markup keeps only the meaning: a heading and a paragraph.

tasks.title: A document with no parse errors
tasks.statement: The browser silently repairs markup, but the errors remain: an unclosed heading, tags closed in the wrong order, a stray closing tag. Fix the document so that it parses with no complaints. Keep the heading “Покупки” (Shopping) and the two list items.
tasks.hint: Every opened tag is closed, in reverse order: …. Just delete the stray closing tag.

tasks.title: An accessible page
tasks.statement: The subscription page is not accessible to a screen reader. Fix it: add the document language, a level-one heading instead of the div “Подписка на рассылку” (Newsletter subscription), a description for the logo in alt, a label for the email field, and wrap the content in main.
tasks.hint: Link the field to its label with for and id: <label for="email">…</label><input id="email">. The logo needs a non-empty alt.

tasks.title: An article, sections and an aside
tasks.statement: Build an article page: an h1 with the title; in main, an article element with two section elements (each with an h2 heading and a paragraph), and next to it an aside with a paragraph.
tasks.hint: Structure: main > article > section × 2 (each with an h2 and a p), and the aside is side content with a paragraph inside.
